h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Eluru

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Eluru

items.pText: Eluru sits among the paddy fields and canals between the Godavari and Krishna deltas, close to Kolleru lake. The weather is hot and humid for most of the year, with heavy rain in the monsoon. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for schools, societies and parks in Eluru from our factory in Vasai, about 920 km away, and delivers it by road.

Many enquiries from towns like Eluru come from schools and small housing projects working with a modest budget. You do not need a large multi play system to give children a good play area. A swing, a slide and a see-saw or spring rider, placed well with enough space around them, cover most of what young children enjoy. We help you pick these individual pieces and place them on a layout drawing, then manufacture and dispatch them from Vasai.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Getting the most from individual equipment

c: Individual pieces are easy to add one at a time and easy to fit around trees and buildings. Choose a 3 ft or 5 ft slide for children under eight, and give a swing set enough clear space in front and behind for the full swing. In Eluru's humid weather, galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats and slides hold up well. Grout the posts on open ground, since soft delta soil can shift after heavy rain. A strip of rubber flooring under the swings and at the foot of each slide takes most of the wear.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 920 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can we start with just two or three pieces?
items.a: Yes. Many schools start small and add pieces later. We plan the full layout first, so each new piece has its own safe play area when it arrives.

items.q: Will the equipment handle Eluru's humid weather?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist rust and moisture well. Grouted foundations hold the equipment firmly in soft or wet soil through the monsoon.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Eluru?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Eluru by road and install it with our own team or a dealer who serves Andhra Pradesh.
